scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,bot -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/bot
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web,bot -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm start -w apps/api" "npm start -w apps/web" "npm start -w apps/bot"
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/bot
